svg.title: CH32V305RBT6 Pico-compatible pinout
svg.desc: USB is at the top. Left header is numbered 1 to 20 downward; right header is numbered 40 to 21 downward.
svg.text: USB ↑ · common alternate functions · physical pin view

g.title: Pin 1: PA2 (MCU pin 16), ADC2, USART2_TX, TIM2_CH3, OPA2_OUT
Pin 2: PA3 (MCU pin 17), ADC3, USART2_RX, TIM2_CH4, OPA1_OUT
Pin 4: PA0 (MCU pin 14), ADC0, WKUP, TIM2_CH1
Pin 6: PA6 (MCU pin 22), ADC6, SPI1_MISO, TIM3_CH1
Pin 7: PA4 (MCU pin 20), ADC4, DAC0, SPI1_NSS
Pin 9: PA5 (MCU pin 21), ADC5, DAC1, SPI1_SCK
Pin 10: PA7 (MCU pin 23), ADC7, SPI1_MOSI, TIM3_CH2
Pin 26: PC7 (MCU pin 38), TIM8_CH2, TIM3_CH2_RM, I2S3_MCK
Pin 25: PC6 (MCU pin 37), TIM8_CH1, TIM3_CH1_RM, I2S2_MCK
Pin 17: PB12 (MCU pin 33), SPI2_NSS, I2S2_WS, CAN2_RX
Pin 24: PB15 (MCU pin 36), SPI2_MOSI, I2S2_SD, SDIO_D1
Pin 21: PB13 (MCU pin 34), SPI2_SCK, I2S2_CK, CAN2_TX
